keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Goal! Brighton and Hove Albion 1, Universitatea Craiova 0. Ibrahim Osman (Brighton and Hove Albion) right footed shot from very close range to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Jack Hinshelwood.
Goal! Brighton and Hove Albion 2, Universitatea Craiova 0. Maxim De Cuyper (Brighton and Hove Albion) right footed shot from outside the box to the bottom right corner.
Delay in match because of an injury Matt O'Riley (Brighton and Hove Albion).
Delay in match (Universitatea Craiova). VAR checking.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Vladimir Screciu (Universitatea Craiova) is shown the red card.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Universitatea Craiova. Steven Nsimba replaces Stefan Baiaram.
Substitution, Universitatea Craiova. Adrian Rus replaces Simon Elisor.
Substitution, Brighton and Hove Albion. Femi Azeez replaces Matt O'Riley.
Substitution, Brighton and Hove Albion. Costinha replaces Maxim De Cuyper.
Substitution, Brighton and Hove Albion. Yasin Ayari replaces Chema Andrés.
Second Half begins Brighton and Hove Albion 2, Universitatea Craiova 0.
Yasin Ayari (Brighton and Hove Albion) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.

Goal! Brighton and Hove Albion 3, Universitatea Craiova 0. Charalampos Kostoulas (Brighton and Hove Albion) left footed shot from the left side of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Ibrahim Osman.
Substitution, Brighton and Hove Albion. Luka Vuskovic replaces Pascal Struijk.

Goal! Brighton and Hove Albion 4, Universitatea Craiova 0. Ibrahim Osman (Brighton and Hove Albion) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Ferdi Kadıoğlu.
Substitution, Universitatea Craiova. Samuel Teles replaces João Lameira.
Substitution, Brighton and Hove Albion. Promise David replaces Pascal Groß.
Substitution, Universitatea Craiova. David Matei replaces Alexandru Cicâldau.
Substitution, Universitatea Craiova. Alexandru Cretu replaces Tudor Baluta.
Delay in match because of an injury Nicusor Bancu (Universitatea Craiova).
Oleksandr Romanchuk (Universitatea Craiova) is shown the yellow card.
Costinha (Brighton and Hove Albion) is shown the yellow card.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Nicusor Bancu (Universitatea Craiova) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
